This mistakes a coverage gap for a parse defect: the Time term inventory (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute) has no week term, so term propagation can only copy the antecedent's stated day-level terms, and (Time sk_count_1 (Year 2)) is true of the content and well-typed.
